SAP-cloud-infrastructure/dual-deployment.description: Kubernetes operator that deploys split host/remote helm chart/kustomization in Gardener environments, rendering a Helm chart or kustomize source per operator and applying each half to its target cluster via server-side apply.
SAP-cloud-infrastructure/dual-deployment.readme_excerpt: A Kubernetes operator for **Gardener** environments that deploys a single Helm chart or kustomize source across **two clusters at once** — the seed (in-cluster) and its shoot (remote) — from one `DualDeploymentOperator` custom resource. You point it at a source, tell it which namespace to use on the shoot, and give it credentials to reach the shoot. On every reconcile it renders the source **twice** (once per cluster), applies your transformations, and server-side-applies each render to its target cluster. SAP-cloud-infrastructure/metal-telemetry.readme_excerpt: A Kubernetes operator that streams hardware telemetry and alert events from Baseboard Management Controllers (BMCs) via the Redfish API and publishes them as Prometheus metrics. The Metal Telemetry Operator (MTO) watches `BMC` resources and maintains persistent Redfish connections to each BMC, collecting two classes of data: **Telemetry** — continuous MetricReport streams delivered either via Server-Sent Events (SSE) for Dell iDRAC and Lenovo XCC3, or via HTTP push webhooks for HPE iLO. SAP-cloud-infrastructure/metaldhcp.name: metaldhcp
SAP-cloud-infrastructure/metaldhcp.readme_excerpt: A DHCP server for bare-metal out-of-band networks. It is built on the coredhcp library — not a fork — and adds a single custom plugin, `oob`, for Kubernetes-native address management. The `oob` plugin handles IPv4 address allocation (DHCPv4 `server4`) and lease persistence: - **Address pools** come from two sources (mutually exclusive): - *Inline subnets* — defined in the plugin config file (`subnets:`), managed by the deployment pipeline or Helm. When present, these are authoritative. - *Subnet CRs* — selected by label (`subnetLabels:`), synced into the cluster by a separate operator. Used when no inline subnets are configured. - **DHCP relay
